title: Build planner silently emits a partial order on dependency cycles
prompt: The task planner hangs or skips jobs when two tasks depend on each other: lib/topo.mjs returns a partial order instead of failing, and the runner happily executes the truncated plan. The documented contract: a cycle is a hard Error mentioning the stuck nodes — a partial order must never be returned silently. Fix lib/topo.mjs and verify with your own script (valid DAG order, diamond, empty graph, 3-cycle, self-edge, unknown node) before answering.
